result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane signalized intersection with significant crossing distances and minimal visible pedestrian infrastructure. The lack of prominent crosswalks, refuge islands, or curb extensions creates a high-exposure environment for pedestrians crossing multiple lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the intersection requires pedestrians to be exposed to multiple lanes of traffic for an extended period without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the image.

hazards.name: Lack of High-Visibility Markings
hazards.description: The absence of clear, high-visibility crosswalk markings reduces driver awareness of potential pedestrian crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: The intersection area where pedestrians would naturally cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Large Vehicles
hazards.description: Large trucks and queued vehicles can block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection where a red truck and other vehicles are queued.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area and reduce unprotected exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a large, multi-lane signalized intersection with significant crossing distances and minimal pedestrian refuge. While crosswalks and signals are present, the scale of the roadway and faded pavement markings create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the intersection requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main roadway

hazards.name: Faded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: Worn lane lines and crosswalk markings reduce visibility and predictability of traffic flow for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Large Vehicles

hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the truck

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area and reduce unprotected exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility continental or ladder style markings to all legs of the intersection to improve driver awareness.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane arterial road with high-visibility zebra crosswalks but no visible signalization. The long crossing distance and lack of a paved refuge island in the median significantly increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four travel lanes plus turn lanes, leading to prolonged exposure to high-speed vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the main arterial road.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The absence of pedestrian signals or traffic lights at such a wide crossing creates high risk for pedestrians attempting to find gaps in traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of the main road and the side street entrance.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: While a grass median exists, there is no paved refuge area or cut-through for pedestrians to wait safely mid-crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway where the crosswalk meets the grass median.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a paved, ADA-compliant refuge island within the median to allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB)
interventions.description: Install a signalized beacon to provide a protected crossing interval for pedestrians on this high-volume arterial.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the overall crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility to drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, but is dominated by a wide, multi-lane arterial road that creates a long crossing distance. While a median cut-through and curb ramps with tactile warnings are present, the overall environment is car-centric with minimal sidewalk connectivity beyond the immediate corner.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of high-speed traffic, significantly increasing their exposure time in the roadway.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide travel lanes and a lack of physical speed-calming measures encourage higher vehicle speeds at the crossing.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to provide a 3-7 second head start for pedestrians before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve the visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Enhanced Median Refuge
interventions.description: Upgrade the median cut-through to a raised, protected refuge island with bollards to provide better physical protection for waiting pedestrians.
